settings.name: ElliottWaveCountData
settings.description: The data ElliottWaveCountLifecycle acts on, from a wave label on the chart to the trading campaign that records the result. Drawn from jgt-analysis-intelligence src/models.py (ChartDrawing, AnalysisArtifact, TradeSetup, SetupArtifactLink, AnalysisStrategyLink), jgt-blueprint-api src/models.py (CampaignMandate, MandateDelegation) and jgt-strategy-api src/models.py (Campaign, TradingStrategy). Attributes whose description starts with 'planned' do not exist yet.
settings.notes: Revision 1, 2026-09-25, from Guillaume's comments G1-G17 on the proposal page. Episode 140 strategic entry, session c9ee574b-0165-44e9-8974-4e83a977ae55. A trading campaign is jgt-strategy-api's campaigns table (instrument, timeframe, direction; groups strategies; counts wins and losses). A project with a target amount to raise is something else: the Project Planner parked in /b/trading/jgt-projects. The blueprint prototype still carries that planner's Campaign (desire_statement, target_amount), CampaignOutcome, ResourcePool and Project tables; they are left out of this chain and their names are under review (action A10). The blueprint itself is a PROTOTYPE that never delivered anything working (Guillaume, 2026-09-24).

entities.name: WaveLabelMark
entities.description: One wave label Guillaume placed on the price chart: a chart_drawings row whose tool is wave_label. Its one anchor is the end point of the wave it names (caishen spec 80 WavePoint); the wave's start is the previous label's point. A mark, not evidence.
entities.notes: Named from specs 80-81 (label, wave point); no spec uses the word pivot, and the BOSf drift review removed it on 2026-09-03. Adding the tool to the store is one TOOL_ANCHORS entry: 'wave_label': 1.

attributes.name: anchors
attributes.description: [{time, price}] - one anchor, the wave's end point

attributes.name: props
attributes.description: planned keys: label (1-5, A-E, X), role (primary | alternate)

entities.name: AoMark
entities.description: An existing drawing on the AO pane (jgwill/jgtsrc#154): ao_divergence, ao_divergence_watch, ao_no_divergence, ao_arrow. Its price is the AO value on the timeframe it was drawn on.
entities.notes: Read as momentum corroboration of a count: W3 carries the highest AO peak of the impulse, W5 makes a new price extreme with a lower AO peak (caishen spec 86; rispecs/consensus-trade-decision.spec.md; jgt-data-server/rispecs/wave-analysis.spec.md).

entities.name: WaveCount
entities.description: The published reading of one instrument and timeframe: an AnalysisArtifact whose artifact_type is wave_count. Agents read it; a TradeSetup cites it.

attributes.name: wave_label
attributes.description: Primary count: the wave in progress

attributes.name: wave_degree
attributes.description: planned rule: derived from timeframe - M1 Cycle, W1 Primary, D1 Intermediate, H4 Minor, H1 Minute, m15 Minuette, m5 Subminuette

attributes.name: key_invalidation_level
attributes.description: planned rule: computed from Elliott's rules over the labels, never typed (G14)

attributes.name: provenance
attributes.description: planned keys: label_ids (the WaveLabelMark rows), ao_mark_ids, wave_identities

attributes.name: reading_state
attributes.description: planned: the Reading and Published state of this point of view; downstream states are held by their owners

entities.name: WaveIdentity
entities.description: Spec 80's wave: start point, end point, label, type. Derived from consecutive labels at publish time and kept in WaveCount.provenance.

entities.name: TradeSetup
entities.description: The typed setup an agent drafts when Guillaume asks for a blueprint from a count; the only door from analysis into the blueprint.

attributes.name: invalidation
attributes.description: {kind, level?, rule?, source_artifact_id?} - planned kind: wave_count, level defaulting to the count's

entities.name: SetupArtifactLink
entities.description: Which analysis a setup was drafted from.

entities.name: CampaignMandate
entities.description: jgt-blueprint-api prototype: what Guillaume authorized once - a copy of the count as it was, the invalidation level he chose, and a validity window.

attributes.name: invalidation
attributes.description: Chosen at authorization, defaulting to the count's level (G14)

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Today references the prototype's own campaigns table, a Project Planner leftover, not jgt-strategy-api's trading campaign (A10)

attributes.name: state
attributes.description: AUTHORIZED | ARMED | TRIGGERED | INVALIDATED | EXPIRED | COMPLETED | PAUSED

entities.name: MandateDelegation
entities.description: The exactly-once creation of a strategy when the mandate sees a breakout point.

attributes.name: breakout_price
attributes.description: planned: the fractal level the strategy breaks out of (G12)

entities.name: TradingCampaign
entities.description: jgt-strategy-api campaigns: a directional intention on one instrument and timeframe that groups strategies and counts their wins and losses. 33 rows, 8 wins, 16 losses on 2026-09-25.

entities.name: TradingStrategy
entities.description: jgt-strategy-api: the strategic entry. Full entity in /b/trading/diagrams/trading-strategy.erdf.json.

attributes.name: strategy_type
attributes.description: fdb_breakout (UI: BOS) | bosf_breakout (UI: BOSf, BOS with a fractal count, not implemented). Both use the FDB principle.

attributes.name: strategy_state
attributes.description: State of the BOS or BOSf machine

entities.name: AnalysisStrategyLink
entities.description: Keeps the count as the strategy's reason, so a trade review walks from an order back to the labels. 0 rows on 2026-09-24.

relationships.label: is corroborated by
relationships.description: provenance.ao_mark_ids; confidence only, never the verdict
